decision_requested: Should Portable Case Pack v1 execute its published Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema as the structural authority before semantic validation?
beneficiary: Lattice maintainers and downstream runtime adapters that rely on Portable Case Pack validity
before_state: The published schema described structural constraints, but CI did not execute those constraints against Portable Case Pack instances.
target_state: CI rejects Portable Case Pack instances that violate the published structural schema before domain semantic validation runs.
acceptance: A valid Portable Case Pack passes Draft 2020-12 structural validation.
The existing semantic validator still checks cross-field evidence invariants after structural validation.
acceptance_observer: repository CI plus repository maintainer review
falsification: Reject this direction if executing the published schema would contradict an intentionally supported Portable Case Pack v1 instance or if structural rules cannot be applied deterministically across supported runtimes.
